item.title: FBI search of Georgia election offices relied on years-old claims of fraud, affidavit shows
item.description: Unsealed affidavit shows FBI search of Fulton County election offices relied on long-disputed 2020 fraud claims referred by Trump adviser, fueling debate over basis for ballot seizure.

item.title: Jackson boys hoops' seniors honored in rout win over Caruthersville
item.description: Jackson honored seniors Ty Forest, Izaac Pursley and Will Thomas, then rolled past Caruthersville 82-29 behind Forest’s 17 points to improve to 20-1 ahead of hosting New Madrid County Central.

item.title: Poplar Bluff wins SEMO Conference Meet as Cape Central's McAlister breaks 100 yard backstroke record
item.description: Poplar Bluff scores 511 points to claim the SEMO Conference girls swimming title, while Cape Central’s Karsynne McAlister sets a 100-yard backstroke record of 56.75 seconds

item.title: Puxico defeats East Carter 81-61 in OFC Semis for trip to title game
item.description: The Puxico Indians overwhelmed the East Carter Redbirds 81-61 on Tuesday night in Naylor to advance to the finals of the Ozark Foothills Conference tournament.

item.title: Greenville beats Doniphan 60-48 in OFC Semis to advance to championship game
item.description: The Greenville Bears outlasted the Doniphan Dons 60-48 on Tuesday night in Naylor to claim a spot in the finals of the Ozark Foothills Conference tournament.

item.title: Asian shares advance after weak US retail data weigh on Wall Street
item.description: BANGKOK (AP) — Shares were moderately higher in Asia on Wednesday after U.S. stocks drifted to a mixed finish following a discouraging report on how much money U.S. retailers made during the holidays.

item.title: Takeaways from AP's review of recent criminal cases against ICE employees and contractors
item.description: At least two dozen U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement employees and contractors have been charged with crimes since 2020, and the wrongdoing includes patterns of physical and sexual abuse, corruption and other misuses of authority, a review by The Associated Press found.

item.title: As ICE expands, an AP review of crimes committed by agents shows how their powers can be abused
item.description: Investigators said one immigration enforcement official got away with physically assaulting his girlfriend for years. Another admitted he repeatedly sexually abused a woman in his custody. A third is charged with taking bribes to remove detention orders on people targeted for deportation.

item.title: Out of the past: Feb. 11
item.description: Feb. 11 snapshots of Cape Girardeau history: a deadly 2001 motel shootout, 1970s city pay grievances, a 1926 beauty contest and early plans for a free bridge over the Mississippi River.
